name: Exp_ColorStepXCCX
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorStepXCCX custom indicator, which uses step-filtered moving averages with dual smoothing. It enters long when the fast line crosses above the slow line and short when it crosses below, with configurable permissions for opening and closing positions independently.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorStepXCCX自定义指标进行交易，该指标使用步进过滤的双重平滑移动平均线。当快线上穿慢线时做多，快线下穿慢线时做空，并支持独立配置开仓和平仓权限。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是基于ColorStepXCCX指标的趋势跟踪，该指标结合了价格平滑（如JJMA）和偏差平滑（如T3）双重算法，再通过快慢步进大小（StepSizeFast/StepSizeSlow）生成信号。入场条件：当指标0号线（MPlus）上穿1号线（MMinus）时产生买入信号，反之产生卖出信号，且仅在交叉发生时（前一Bar未交叉、当前Bar交叉）才触发开仓。出场条件：反向交叉信号触发平仓，同时设有固定的StopLoss和TakeProfit点数进行风控。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值代表固定手数，正值代表按存款比例计算仓位。资金管理依赖TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen函数实现，支持偏差控制（Deviation）防止滑点。策略还通过IsNewBar机制确保每个Bar仅计算一次信号，避免重复交易。
strategy_analysis_en: The EA's core strategy is trend following based on the ColorStepXCCX indicator, which combines dual smoothing algorithms — price smoothing (e.g., JJMA) and deviation smoothing (e.g., T3) — then generates signals through fast and slow step sizes. Entry conditions: a buy signal triggers when buffer 0 (MPlus) crosses above buffer 1 (MMinus), and a sell signal triggers on the opposite crossover, with the additional requirement that the prior bar showed no crossover (confirming a fresh cross). Exit conditions: reverse crossover signals close positions, supplemented by fixed StopLoss and TakeProfit values in points for risk control. Position sizing is governed by the MM parameter: negative values specify a fixed lot size, while positive values represent a share of the deposit per deal. Money management relies on the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions (BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen), which include deviation control to manage slippage. The strategy also uses an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing duplicate trades within the same bar.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 存款份额或固定手数（负值为手数）
parameters.description_en: Deposit percentage or fixed lot; negative value = lot size

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大价格偏差（滑点容忍度）

pros: 使用双重平滑算法（JJMA+T3），信号质量较高，减少噪音干扰
支持独立控制开仓和平仓权限，灵活性好，可单独禁止买入或卖出
有IsNewBar新Bar检测机制，避免同一Bar内重复计算和交易
StopLoss和TakeProfit设置合理，默认盈亏比2:1，有利于长期盈利
步进过滤机制能有效减少震荡行情中的频繁假信号
pros_en: Dual smoothing algorithms (JJMA+T3) produce higher quality signals with reduced noise
Independent control over buy/sell open and close permissions provides flexible configuration
IsNewBar mechanism prevents redundant signal calculation and duplicate trades within the same bar
Reasonable StopLoss/TakeProfit defaults with a 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio favoring long-term profitability
Step filtering mechanism effectively reduces frequent false signals in choppy markets
cons: 依赖自定义指标ColorStepXCCX，该指标需单独安装，增加了部署复杂度
缺少点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能产生不利入场
无仓位检查逻辑，可能在不同条件下重复开仓
止损1000点和止盈2000点对于某些品种可能过大或过小，未做自适应调整
MM参数的正负值逻辑不够直观，容易造成误配置
cons_en: Depends on the custom ColorStepXCCX indicator which must be installed separately, increasing deployment complexity
No spread filter, potentially leading to unfavorable entries in high-spread conditions
No explicit position check logic, potentially allowing duplicate position openings under certain conditions
StopLoss 1000 and TakeProfit 2000 points may be too large or small for some instruments without adaptive adjustment
The positive/negative MM parameter logic is unintuitive and prone to misconfiguration
improvements: 增加点差过滤器，在点差过大时暂停交易，避免不利滑点
增加持仓检查，避免同方向重复开仓，并可限制最大持仓数量
将MM参数拆分为独立的仓位模式选择和手数/比例参数，提高可读性
improvements_en: Add a spread filter to pause trading when spread exceeds a threshold, avoiding unfavorable slippage
Add position checking to prevent duplicate same-direction opens and allow max position limits
Split the MM parameter into separate position sizing mode and lot/ratio parameters for better readability

risk_points: 缺少点差过滤，高点差时入场价格可能不利
MM参数负值代表固定手数的逻辑容易误操作，可能意外使用过大手数
依赖外部自定义指标，若指标文件缺失则EA无法正常运行
risk_points_en: No spread filter means entry prices may be unfavorable during high-spread periods
The negative MM value for fixed lots is error-prone and could accidentally use oversized lots
Dependency on external custom indicator means EA fails silently if indicator file is missing
